accented: viṣṇo̱ḥ nu ka̍ṁ vī̱ryā̍ṇi̱ pra vo̍ca̱ṁ
lines: viṣṇoḥ nu kaṁ vīryāṇi pra vocaṁ

items.text:
viṣṇor nu kaṁ vīryāṇi pra vocaṁ
yaḥ pārthivāni vimame rajām̐si
yo  askabhāyad uttaram̐ sadhasthaṁ
vicakramāṇas tredhorugāyo1॥

translation.en: I now proclaim the heroic deeds of Viṣṇu, who measured out the earthly spaces, who propped up the upper dwelling-place, striding wide three times.

entries.note: the old accusative of ka-, used adverbially in the Veda
aorist a-vocam; the augment is lost after pra in recitation
perfect ātmanepada
imperfect a-skabhāyat
tredhā + urugāyaḥ; the visarga becomes -o before the voiced v- of viṣṇoḥ

accented: viṣṇo̍ḥ a̱rāṭa̍m asi̱ viṣṇo̎ḥ pṛ̱ṣṭham a̍si̱
viṣṇo̱ḥ śnaptre̎ stho̱ viṣṇo̱ḥ syūḥ a̍si̱
lines: viṣṇoḥ arāṭam asi viṣṇoḥ pṛṣṭham asi
viṣṇoḥ śnaptre stho viṣṇoḥ syūḥ asi

items.text:
viṣṇor arāṭam asi viṣṇoḥ pṛṣṭham asi
viṣṇoś śnaptre stho viṣṇos syūr asi
viṣṇor dhruvam asi vaiṣṇavam asi
viṣṇave tvā ॥2॥

translation.en: You are Viṣṇu's edge; you are Viṣṇu's back; you two are Viṣṇu's jaws; you are Viṣṇu's seam; you are Viṣṇu's firm point. You belong to Viṣṇu — you, for Viṣṇu.

entries.note: a Vedic word of uncertain sense, glossed in the ritual commentaries as an edge or forepart of the pressing apparatus; the rendering is provisional
VedaVMS prints the palatalised recitation śñaptre; the standard reading is śnaptra-
sthaḥ; the visarga becomes -o before the voiced v-
syūḥ; visarga → r before the following vowel

accented: tad a̍sya pri̱yam a̱bhi pātho̍ aśyām |
lines: tad asya priyam abhi pātho aśyām |

items.text:
tad asya priyam abhi pātho  aśyām ।
naro yatra devayavo madanti ।
urukramasya sa hi bandhur itthā ।
viṣṇoḥ pade parame madhva  utsaḥ3॥

translation.en: May I reach that dear pasture of his, where men devoted to the gods rejoice; for there is the true kinship with the wide-strider — in Viṣṇu's highest step is a spring of honey.

entries.note: pāthaḥ; visarga → -o before the following vowel

entries.meaning: may I reach, may I attain
entries.note: optative (āśīrliṅ)
uru- + krama-, an epithet of Viṣṇu
madhvaḥ; visarga lost before the following vowel

items.text:
pra tad viṣṇus stavate vīryāya ।
mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ ।
yasyoruṣu triṣu vikramaṇeṣu ।
adhikṣiyanti bhuvanāni viśvā4॥

translation.en: For this is Viṣṇu praised, for his heroic power — dread as a roaming beast that haunts the mountains, in whose three wide strides all the worlds have their dwelling.

entries.note: ātmanepada with passive sense
the Taittirīya reading; a Ṛgveda edition has the instrumental vīryeṇa

entries.meaning: like, as (comparative particle in the Veda)

entries.note: giri- + -sthā
yasya + uruṣu

accented: u̱bhe te̍ vidma̱ raja̍sī pṛthi̱vyā viṣṇo̍ deva̱ tvam |
lines: ubhe te vidma rajasī pṛthivyā viṣṇo deva tvam |

items.text:
paro mātrayā tanuvā vṛdhāna ।
na te mahitvam anvaśnuvanti ।
ubhe te vidma rajasī pṛthivyā viṣṇo deva tvam ।
paramasya vitse5॥

translation.en: Grown beyond all measure in your body — none attain your greatness. We know both your realms, of earth and of heaven; O Viṣṇu, O god, you know the highest.

entries.note: paraḥ used adverbially with the instrumental mātrayā
the Taittirīya reading; a Ṛgveda edition has tanvā

entries.meaning: O you who grow, waxing great
entries.note: present middle participle of √vṛdh

entries.meaning: like, as (comparative particle in the Veda)

entries.note: perfect with present sense
ātmanepada, governing the genitive

items.text:
vicakrame pṛthivīm eṣa  etām ।
kṣetrāya viṣṇur manuṣe daśasyann ।
dhruvāso  asya kīrayo janāsaḥ ।
urukṣitim̐ sujanimā cakāra6॥

translation.en: This one strode across this earth, that Viṣṇu might grant it as a dwelling-field for man; steadfast are his singers, his people; he made a wide abode and a good birth.

entries.note: perfect ātmanepada

entries.meaning: for a field, for a dwelling-ground

entries.note: present participle of the denominative daśasya-; the doubled -nn is the Taittirīya pāda-final form
Vedic nom. pl. in -āsaḥ
Vedic nom. pl. in -āsaḥ
uru- + kṣiti-; the short u is the reading of both accented witnesses

items.text:
trir devaḥ pṛthivīm eṣa  etām ।
vicakrame śatarcasaṁ mahitvā ।
pra viṣṇur astu tavasas tavīyān ।
tveṣam̐ hyasya sthavirasya nāma7॥

translation.en: Three times this god strode across this earth, of hundredfold-hymned greatness. Let Viṣṇu be mightier than the mighty, for awesome is the name of him, the enduring one.

entries.note: perfect ātmanepada
ablative of comparison with the comparative tavīyān
hi + asya

accented: ato̍ de̱vā a̍vantu no̱ yato̱ viṣṇu̍ḥ vicakra̱me |
lines: ato devā avantu no yato viṣṇuḥ vicakrame |

items.text:
ato devā  avantu no yato viṣṇur vicakrame ।
pṛthivyās sapta dhāmabhiḥ8॥

translation.en: From there may the gods protect us — from where Viṣṇu strode out, through the seven stations of the earth.

entries.meaning: let them favour, let them protect

entries.note: the enclitic naḥ; visarga → -o before the voiced y-
perfect ātmanepada
pṛthivyāḥ; visarga assimilated to the following s-
in agreement with dhāmabhiḥ

accented: i̱daṁ viṣṇu̱ḥ vica̍krame tre̱dhā ni da̍dhe pa̱dam |
lines: idaṁ viṣṇuḥ vicakrame tredhā ni dadhe padam |

items.text:
idaṁ viṣṇur vicakrame tredhā ni dadhe padam ।
samūḍham asya pām̐sure9॥

translation.en: Viṣṇu strode across this world; three times he set down his step; it lies gathered up in his dust.

entries.note: perfect ātmanepada
perfect ātmanepada, with the preverb ni

accented: trīṇi̍ pa̱dā vica̍krame viṣṇu̍ḥ go̱pā adā̎bhyaḥ |
lines: trīṇi padā vicakrame viṣṇuḥ gopā adābhyaḥ |

items.text:
trīṇi padā vicakrame viṣṇur gopā  adābhyaḥ ।
tato dharmāṇi dhārayann10॥

translation.en: Three steps Viṣṇu strode, the guardian none may deceive, upholding thence the ordinances.

entries.note: Vedic nom./acc. pl. in -ā
perfect ātmanepada
go- + -pā, a root-noun compound
the Taittirīya reading; the Ṛgveda has ataḥ. A recension difference, not an error
present participle of the causative of √dhṛ; the doubled -nn is the Taittirīya pāda-final form

accented: viṣṇo̱ḥ karmā̍ṇi paśyata̱ yato̎ vra̱tāni̍ paspa̱śe |
lines: viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi paśyata yato vratāni paspaśe |

items.text:
viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi paśyata yato vratāni paspaśe ।
indrasya yujyas sakhā11॥

translation.en: Behold the works of Viṣṇu, by which he has kept watch over the sacred observances — Indra's fitting companion.

entries.note: the suppletive present paśya- serves √dṛś

entries.meaning: he has kept watch over, has beheld
entries.note: perfect ātmanepada

entries.meaning: fit to be yoked with, suitable
entries.note: yujyaḥ; visarga assimilated to the following s-
irregular nom. sg. sakhā

accented: tad viṣṇo̎ḥ para̱maṁ pa̱daṁ sadā̍ paśyanti sū̱raya̍ḥ |
lines: tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṁ padaṁ sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ |

items.text:
tad viṣṇoḥ paramam padam̐ sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ ।
divīva cakṣur ātatam12॥

translation.en: That highest step of Viṣṇu the seers behold for ever, set wide like an eye in heaven.

entries.note: divi + iva

items.source: Ṛgveda 1.22.21 · in Taittirīya recitation · parallel: Ṛgveda 1.22.21
items.text:
tad viprāso vipanyavo jāgṛvām̐sas samindhate ।
viṣṇor yat paramam padam13॥

translation.en: That which the inspired, the praise-loving, the ever-wakeful kindle — that highest step of Viṣṇu.

entries.note: Vedic nom. pl. in -āsaḥ
perfect active participle of √jāgṛ

items.text:
paryāptyā  anantarāyāya sarvastomo 'tirātra
uttama mahar bhavati
sarvasyāptyai sarvasya jittyai
sarvam eva tenāpnoti sarvañ jayati

translation.en: For full attainment, for freedom from interruption, the sarvastoma atirātra becomes the final day — for the winning of all, for the conquest of all; by it one wins all, one conquers all.

entries.note: pari-√āp; the witnesses read the instrumental paryāptyā
an- + antarāya; the anusvāra is written un-assimilated in the source and the engine derives the n

entries.meaning: the sarvastoma (a soma rite in which every stoma is employed)
the atirātra, the overnight soma rite

uttamam; the final -m is carried over to the next word in the recited division uttama mahar

entries.meaning: for the winning, for the obtaining
entries.note: sarvasya + āptyai
the geminate -tty- is the reading of both witnesses for this passage and is kept; the grammatical form is jityai
tena + āpnoti
sarvam; the anusvāra assimilates to the palatal nasal before j-
